name: @2jumpsina/dsh-context-guard
description: DSH context-pressure guard: when a session's next request would carry a dangerously large prompt, tell the user at turn end to write the handoff and start a new session. Consumes the official token-meter contextPressure projection; injects no prompt, registers no model-facing tool, so its context tax is zero. v0.3: at 45% occupancy the host half auto-drafts a machine-facts handover block into the session working directory; v0.2 added the host state route and an opt-in (default off) WeChat push; v0.3.2 onwards ships bilingual (zh/en, auto-detected per half) runtime copy; v0.3.3 was a docs-only release that fixed the install instructions once the package was live on npm; v0.3.4 fixed cross-platform absolute-path detection in resolveHandoverPath and moved publishing to CI with npm trusted publishing (OIDC); v0.3.5 adds a second banner choice (write the handoff now, with a copy-ready @mention opener) backed by a POST draft route; v0.3.6 makes the to-fill-in area survive refreshes (sub-markers) so conclusions an agent writes are never overwritten; v0.4.0 turns the banner into two copy-ready handoff texts (fill the conclusions here / open the next session) with a todoFilled flag, and adds a zero-LLM pre-compaction snapshot block (the platform's compaction is a black box; this keeps the pre-compaction occupancy/spend/files); v0.4.1 declares the DSH host requirement via engines.dsh; v0.4.2 fixes the compaction/end failure payload (0.2.0 sends an error string, so the old `error !== true` check treated failures as successes), makes respectCompaction reachable by the host half (the atTurnBoundary conjunction was never satisfied), and widens engines.dsh to cover the 0.2.x line including 0.2.0 release candidates (npm semver excludes prereleases unless the comparator set itself carries a prerelease on the same major.minor.patch, so <0.3.0-0 alone does not cover 0.2.0-rc.2). v0.4.3 registers the host decision as its own wire projection (key contextGuard, stateVersion 0: level/armed/turn/cooldown/ratio, flat JSON, same-reference when unchanged) so the browser half reads level and cooldown instead of computing them; the client state machine, the STATE_ROUTE fetch, hostSync/setHostConfig and the settleTurn-on-button hook are gone, and the state machine moved out of policy.mjs into engine.mjs (host-only) so the client bundle can no longer carry a second judge; engine decisions are now a pure fold (init + apply(state, event)) and the compaction marker lives in the folded state, derived from compaction/* events. The STATE_ROUTE stays as a read-only debug mirror.
author: dsh-context-guard contributors
